test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Four friends Himani, Shalaka, Mitali and Brinda are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. All four of them are sitting at the corners of the table. Himani is to the immediate right of Brinda. Mitali is to the immediate left of Shalaka. Himani is second to the left of Shalaka. After some time, Himani leaves her place and is replaced by Kamini. Similarly, Brinda is also replaced by Tara. Now who is sitting to the immediate left of Tara?
solution:
Given:

 
• Four friends: Himani, Shalaka, Mitali, and Brinda are sitting around the square table facing the center of the table.
 
• All of them are sitting at the corners of the table.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed87a6caa34fdaceb0e1405004cdf7ae65be7b0c949cc3ff2409436af7cbc5d5.png] 

The sitting arrangement is as follows,

 
• Himani is sitting right of Brinda.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16ad25ee65c7bffc0d2775675979fe3f382d28bd09bfbb05c8110049c3e8949e.png] 

 
• Himani is second to the left of Shalaka.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9527b91d6e28b330440f4df6e83f360b70d690501c47e36a807a6a8cc030d143.png] 

 
• Mitali is immediately left of Shalaka.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/714aab5430b31f5b836c41c5443297b768e525c729f58008efde531de94415af.png] 

Now, 

 
• Himani is replaced by Kamini.
 
• Brinda is replaced by Tara.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7780cd56a95354cf425bbf36004359f72d2b5229ea970f3a4ca776814557bd7.png] 

Thus, **Shalaka** is sitting immediately left to Tara.

Hence, the correct answer is** option 3)**.
